top_comments.author: @bigdataon-premorcloud7866
top_comments.text:
It is an interesting perspective. I can certainly see where Skillopt has its place, especially for exploratory work where creativity and experimentation can lead to valuable discoveries.

That said, if I may offer another perspective, businesses operating in highly regulated and compliance-driven environments often benefit more from well-trained, fine-tuned models than from systems designed to think outside the box and learn from their mistakes. In these industries, even a single compliance error can have extraordinarily serious consequences, with costs that may reach hundreds of millions—or even billions—of dollars.

I truly appreciate the innovation behind exploratory approaches, and I believe they can be incredibly valuable in the right context. At the same time, for organizations where accuracy, consistency, and regulatory compliance are paramount, a more controlled and predictable approach is often the safer choice.
